why_this_moment: Scrubbed all 89 frames of the Launch Trailer (fps=1 contact sheets, viewed). The trailer's beauty peaks are the beach aerial (55s), the night skyline (17s), the pink-sunset logo (24s) and the golden-hour balcony embrace (67s) — every one of them reads instantly at phone size, no dialogue needed. The montage opens with the single most postcard-perfect shot (beach + pink plane) so the Short hooks in under a second, then runs day->night->sunset->night as a love letter to Vice City, and closes on Rockstar's own OUT NOW card. No Trailer 2 footage (licensed music / Content ID risk). No DEANKT VOD — the VOD fetch is blocked (YouTube throttles DASH, --download-sections fails on this live VOD).
